Messages.Author: Sorrow
Messages.Body:
> 1. Can i play Delaying Tactics AFTER votes are cast?

Yes. You can play it any time up until the very end of the
referendum.

> 2. Assuming yes, what happens to the Bewitching Orations
> played by the acting minion? Are they burned or get back to
> hand?

They are burned. They were played for votes, were they not?

> 3. After a DT has been played does the controller of the acting
> minion have to reduce his hand because he gets "extra" cards
> in his hand?

I'm not sure what you are asking here. Until the PA is complete,
which is at the end of the referendum, no cards may be replaced
by any meth, including the player who played the Delaying Tactics.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Sorrow wrote:
>
> > 1. Can i play Delaying Tactics AFTER votes are cast?
>

> Yes. You can play it any time up until the very end of the
> referendum.

Correct.

> > 2. Assuming yes, what happens to the Bewitching Orations
> > played by the acting minion? Are they burned or get back to
> > hand?
>

> They are burned. They were played for votes, were they not?

Correct. DT says nothing about retrieving cards other than the
Political Action card (if any).

> > 3. After a DT has been played does the controller of the acting
> > minion have to reduce his hand because he gets "extra" cards
> > in his hand?
>

> I'm not sure what you are asking here. Until the PA is complete,
> which is at the end of the referendum, no cards may be replaced
> by any meth, including the player who played the Delaying Tactics.

Any time a Methuselah has more cards in her hand than her hand size,
she must discard down to her hand size immediately (and she chooses
which card(s) to discard).
